sources.title: Demucs - Open Laboratory
sources.snippet: Demucs is a music source separation model based on a U-Net convolutional architecture, currently capable of separating drums, bass, and vocals from the rest of the accompaniment.

sources.title: Demucs - a Hugging Face Space by aimuzik
sources.snippet: Upload an audio file to separate it into multiple stems (e.g., vocals, instruments). Choose a model, output format, shifts, and overlap for better quality. Download the separated audio stems.
